description: South African electricity distribution and food infrastructure (2025) is a data set deposited in nrf.saeon by its authors Inge Ossentjuk. This dataset contains layers for electricity distribution infrastructure (both substations and cables (power lines)) as well as commercial food infrastructure (supermarkets), as taken from OpenStreetMap in 2025. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: GeoPackage. Size stated: 2 MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is OPEN DATA COMMONS OPEN DATABASE LICENSE (ODBL). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
